newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean police move toward German colony - report.
newsitem.headline: Chilean police move toward German colony - report.

text.p: A large contingent of police early on Tuesday moved toward a secretive German colony in southern Chile where its fugitive leader was believed to be hiding, but stopped short of entering, state television reported.
In what for a moment looked like the beginning of the storming of the colony, police in trucks passed the colony's first gate but stopped short of an inner gate.
Tension has been building for days around the heavily guarded Colonia Dignidad (Dignity Colony), whose fugitive German leader Paul Schaeffer is wanted on child abuse and other charges.
Church bells rang inside the colony and residents lit a huge bonfire, for reasons not completely clear, as a convoy of police vehicles neared the gates.
